05/Dated: 14 March, 2024
1.

The present criminal writ petition has been filed for the following reliefs :-
(a) For issuance of appropriate writ/ order or direction for quashing the cognizance of offence order dated 19.01.2021 (Annexure-4) and entire proceeding passed by learned SDJM, Chatra whereby and where under SDJM, Chatra was pleased to find a prima facie case against the present petitioners under sections 341/323/504/506/ of Indian Penal Code in connection with Piparwar PS case No. 34/2020 corresponding to GR Case No. 1205/2022 and accordingly took cognizance of the same and this case is now pending in the Court of learned SDJM, Chatra.

sentences.text: (b) The petitioner further prays to stay the operation in connection with Piparwar PS case No. 34/2020 corresponding to GR Case No. 1205/2022 during pendency of this writ petition, now pending in the learned court of Md. Adnan Aqueeb, SDJM, Chatra.

2. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the alleged informant/
respondent No.2 is samdhi (in-law) of the petitioner No.1.
The daughter of applicant No.1 and the alleged informant/ respondent No.2 of the present case are on litigating terms.
The daughter of the petitioner No.1 has filed case under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code against the respondent No.2 and as a counter blast, the present case has been lodged.
It has been submitted that the entire incident is highly improbable as the place of occurrence is the house of the informant/ respondent No.2.
It has further been submitted that it is nothing but a malicious prosecution and it is the counterblast to the case filed by the daughter of the petitioner No.1.
3. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer and it has been submitted that the police after due investigation has found that the victim/ informant has been assaulted.
Accordingly, the charge-sheet has been submitted.

4. Considering the investigation, I am not inclined to interfere with the order taking cognizance and accordingly, the present criminal writ petition is, hereby, disposed of giving liberty to the petitioners to raise all the points at the time of framing of charge.
5. With above observation and liberty, the present criminal writ petition is hereby, disposed of.
6. Pending interlocutory application, if any, stands disposed of.
(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Chandan/-
